title: Astra workflow with codex taking forever on tasks
author: IriFlina
selftext:
Anyone have experience with trying to wrangle Astra?

I think Ive somehow over engineered my agents.md file and now even a basic task like making a portrait art moved to be closer to a dialogue box takes Astra 2-3 hours as it looks like it’s trying to set up a test scene then actually run through the tests as well as doing multiple round of code reviews and writing tests for the change.

Should i just try wiping my Agents.md file and starting with a basic one?

Note this is ran on Astra low speed where ive also told it to delegate implementation to sol-high.

comments.author: Old-Preference5313
comments.body: Tell it to stop over engineering and use Medium on fast

comments.author: PlaidWorld
comments.body: Sit down with an AI and talk about whats in your agents file and what the problems are are have have it clean it up for you..
